Jeopardy!

Los Angeles

The all-new season of the top-rated quiz show Jeopardy! will be back taping in July!

Why watch it at home when you can be part of the live studio audience?

Hosted by Ken Jennings with a weekly audience of over 27 million viewers. JEOPARDY! is the top-rated quiz show on television. Come join us in the live studio audience.

Don’t Miss Out! Submit for Tickets Now. If you see “Get Tickets” on the date you request, then they are available. You can print your ticket or keep on your device to show at studio entrance. That is your ticket. If you see “Submit Info”, the show is full or tickets have not been released. Input your information to be notified when tickets will be released.

Everyone in your party must obtain their own ticket.

To allow as many fans as possible to see the show live, please choose only one arrival per day. If you would like to stay for additional arrivals, check with our audience coordinator onsite.

All audience members under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.

You must bring an ID to be admitted to the taping:
Valid Government-Issued Photo Identification: (adults) drivers license or passport, (minors) school ID or birth certificate.

Parking information, and check-in instructions will be on your ticket.

Jeopardy! generally tapes a total of 5 shows a day with 2 different audiences. Audiences will either see the taping of 2 or 3 episodes. Please allow approximately 4 to 5 hours for your entire Jeopardy! experience from arrival through the conclusion of the final taping.
If you have questions, please email Tickets@ocatv.com.

We cannot wait to see you in the studio audience of Jeopardy!
